It is stated that FIR bearing no.0515/2022 registered under section 354 IPC at P.S. Sangam Vihar has also been ordered to be quashed by the another coordinate Bench of this court in CRL.M.C.9142/2023.
6.

The respondent no.2 filed a complaint before CAW Cell, Delhi which was culminated into registration of the present FIR bearing no. 0137/2023 registered under sections 498A/406/354/34 IPC at P.S Sangam Vihar wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The petitioner nos. 2 to 5 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no.1.
The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 are identified by the Investigating Officer ASI Sunil Kumar, P.S. Sangam Vihar as well as by their respective counsel.
The investigation is still pending and the charge-sheet has not been filed.

The petition bearing CT cases no.1139/2022 was referred to the Delhi Mediation Centre, Saket Courts, New Delhi whereby the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 06.02.2023 whereby they have agreed to dissolve their marriage by way of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

The petitioner no.1 has also agreed to pay Rs.6,40,000/- along with return of dowry articles as mentioned in the settlement to the respondent no.2 towards full and final satisfaction of her claims/legal entitlements (past,
present and future) including permanent alimony/maintenance/istridhan etc., other miscellaneous and legal expenses as per the schedule as mentioned in the Settlement Deed.
The petitioner no.1 has already paid Rs.5,00,000/- to the respondent no.2 which is acknowledged by the respondent no.2.

The petitioner no.1 also delivered a demand draft of Rs.1,40,000/- bearing no. 000352 dated 20.10.2023 drawn on Bank of India which is accepted by the respondent no. 2.
8.

The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has been dissolved by way of decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B (2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 by the court of Sh. Paramjit Singh, Principal Judge, Family Court, South, Saket Court, New, Delhi vide judgment dated 21.08.2023 in petition bearing HMA no.1577/2023 titled as Mayank Yadav and X.
9.
